production_prompts.prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION 2D CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS ATLAS of this EXACT user-approved adult blonde pink light mage. Do not redesign her face, high-waisted costume, fuller thighs, gently shaped calves or slender tall proportions. Match the uneven dark contour and broad matte hand-painted angular shadow style.
Portrait 2:3 canvas with EXACTLY THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 12 rectangular cells, NO labels or grid lines. EXACTLY ONE separated complete part in each cell, centered with at least 8% empty transparent margin, NEVER crossing cells. Parts can differ in size/scale between cells; a rig will rescale them. ALL background between and around parts must be fully TRANSPARENT alpha=0, no gray backdrop, gradients, fog or halo.
ROW 1 CELL 1: complete HEAD from hair tips to lower neck, same fair face and warm brown open eyes in three-quarter right-facing view, blonde bangs, earrings, gold cat hairpin and pink ribbon. NO long ponytail, no torso.
ROW 1 CELL 2: EXACT SAME complete head, same view, scale, face, hair, earrings and neck as cell1, with eyes gently CLOSED for blinking. No long ponytail, no torso.
ROW 1 CELL 3: ONLY upper torso/costume, neck collar through shoulders and covered bust to the NATURAL HIGH WAIST gold belt just below ribs. Same ivory short capelet and pink/gold bodice; SHORT bodice, no long abdominal corset, no hips and NO skirt/extra skirt panels, no head or arms. Include a small hidden overlap below the gold waist belt.
ROW 2 CELL 1: ONLY complete high-waisted pink skirt with same gold vertical trim, embroidery and ivory layered hem as reference, waist through mid-thigh hem. No torso, no legs. It hangs from the high belt, not low hips. Keep the single clean skirt design, avoid adding extra duplicate layers.
ROW 2 CELL 2: ONLY the full flowing ivory back cape with gold leaf/sun embroidery, dusty-pink lining, attachment at nape, draping toward left. No shoulder capelet, no person.
ROW 2 CELL 3: ONLY complete blonde wavy SIDE PONYTAIL, attached at top, with matching pink ribbon, draping down naturally. No head.
ROW 3 CELL 1: STAFF-HOLDING ARM complete shoulder-to-fingers, ivory puffed sleeve, pink-gold cuff, fair hand curled around an invisible staff; bent diagonal gesture matching reference. Do not include staff. No torso.
ROW 3 CELL 2: FREE CASTING ARM complete shoulder-to-fingers, same sleeve/cuff and open palm up toward right. No spell and no torso.
ROW 3 CELL 3: ONLY the entire slim golden sun-headed wand, straight upright, no hand, no broad glow.
ROW 4 CELL 1: BACK/LEFT LEG complete from upper thigh (hidden joint) through knee, calf, ankle and pink lace-up boot. Fuller natural thigh and gently shaped calf EXACTLY as the approved reference, not extremely thin. Ivory opaque stocking, slight left slant, boot toes right. No skirt, no second leg.
ROW 4 CELL 2: FRONT/RIGHT LEG complete from upper thigh to boot, same approved leg volume, long balanced thigh and calf, knee at natural height, near straight with toes right. No skirt or second leg.
ROW 4 CELL 3: ONLY the little curling pink and pale-gold light spell from reference, compact clear shape on fully transparent surrounding space. No hand or wand.
All joint surfaces concealed by overlap must be complete for rotation. Do not assemble a whole character anywhere. No background, text, watermark or extra parts.

Create a PRODUCTION 2D CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS ATLAS of the EXACT approved natural long-haired domestic CAT in the reference. Preserve its intelligent attentive eyes, ordinary cat muzzle and whiskers, long full ruff and plume tail, cream/silver/warm-grey coat markings, natural four-legged feline anatomy and matte painted angular fur tufts. No human features, hairstyle, clothing, ribbons, jewelry, collar, cape, smiles or magical accessories.
Landscape 3:2 canvas divided into EXACTLY THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows: 6 equal rectangular cells, no grid lines and no text labels. EXACTLY one centered complete separate part per cell, at least 10% blank transparent padding. Parts never touch another cell; varying scales between cells is intentional for later rig assembly. EVERY area outside the solid fur silhouettes must be fully TRANSPARENT alpha=0, no grey background or shadows behind parts.
ROW1CELL1: only horizontal natural cat BODY from neck attachment through shoulders, long torso and haunch, in right-facing three-quarter low ready stance. Include long ruff and thick fur over shoulder/hip joints, but NO head, NO tail, NO lower legs/paws. The front shoulder is at right, rump at left. Neutral long-haired-cat body, not upright humanoid.
ROW1CELL2: complete natural cat HEAD including ears, muzzle, whiskers and little lower-neck fur for overlap, facing right, same alert clever open eyes, normal feline pupils and expression. No body and no mane hiding the whole jaw.
ROW1CELL3: EXACT SAME head, same pose, scale and marking alignment as cell2, eyes gently CLOSED. No other changes.
ROW2CELL1: only full bushy curving TAIL, attached at left-bottom, curled up/back, cream-grey coat and fluffy tip. No body.
ROW2CELL2: only FRONT LEG with paw, from hidden shoulder joint down to grounded paw, natural feline foreleg contour and long fur, paw toes face right. Include sufficient upper-leg overlap behind the body. No human arm shape.
ROW2CELL3: only REAR LEG and paw including natural cat hip/haunch, bent hock and grounded paw, right-facing stance, long fur. Correct feline anatomy, no human knee or biped pose.
Fur silhouette clean and complete, natural adult cat proportions, no chibi or giant human-like eyes. No assembled full cat anywhere, no extra duplicates, no scenery, no halo. Match the approved cat design rather than a costumed mascot.

Background extraction ONLY for the exact approved full-body character image. Remove the plain warm-grey background and its ground shadow to true transparent alpha=0. Preserve the entire illustrated blonde adult woman, exact high waist and tall proportions, approved thigh/calf thickness, face, expression, pink/white/gold outfit, cape, ponytail, hands, wand and small spell precisely as they are. No redraw or redesign, no body adjustments, no added glow. Keep same portrait framing and full body with boots intact. Clean transparent cutout for the in-game character selection illustration.
